work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent act XVI has synopsis 15885–15889, its own title-linked note 15891–15894, literal protocol 15897–15901 and incipit 15907. The Nankim subject and complete nine-section enactment are distinct from following Pekim XVII, which is already accepted beginning 16309. The complete outer substantive erection, jurisdiction, boundaries, endowment and patronage provisions are printed, with the operative erection at 16033–16126. Preserves all historical notes/corrections at 15946–15953, 16002–16010, 16116–16118, 16167–16169 and 16222–16228. The note at 15951–15953 describes a historical editorial deletion; retained OCR is not altered. Original dating 16301–16304 and editorial dating 16306 remain verbatim. The preceding accepted XV marginal tail through 15880 remains untouched.
